lines: Stars fall onto the hand I hold out between my fingers
I cover my ears, wanting to run away from tomorrow
I walk searching for some dreamland
My naked voice sinks into the dawn waves
I whisper again, believing it reaches
Even if my wings break, I keep going far away
My body lifts and I take flight
Resonate
Resonate
Resonate
Overflow
Now I rise within this miracle
We are weak, but we sing
We hide our cuts with both hands
We are scared, but we sing
In a dry, trembling little heart
Dreams fill it
A journey toward tomorrow
Unconsciously I keep avoiding being hurt
A painless darkness feels gentle
Alone, I abandoned even sleeping and walking
From the night sealed deep in my pulse
A melody blurs, continuing toward tomorrow
My chest opens, spilling out
My own story
Play it
Play it
Spread
Keep connecting
I won’t hesitate any longer; I start running
Even if it never reaches, I will sing
In the light, until my voice runs out
Even if it never reaches, I’ll sing to you
Holding my hand from that day, I kick yesterday away
A journey toward tomorrow
The specks of light I traced
I grasp them, then they vanish
Staggering, I stop my feet now
I’ve lost even the confidence to be sure
Mistake? Right?
But I keep moving
We are weak, but we sing
We hide our cuts with both hands
We are scared, but we sing
In a dry, trembling little heart
Dreams fill it
A journey toward tomorrow
Even if it never reaches, I will sing
In the light, until my voice runs out
Even if it never reaches, I’ll sing to you
Holding my hand from that day, I kick yesterday away
A journey toward tomorrow
